home.bioParagraph1: Hello! I'm Fran, a recent Computer Engineering graduate from the University of León (ULE). Having finished my studies and defended my Final Degree Project, I am looking for my first full-time role as a Full-Stack software developer. My goal is to join a team where I can add value and continue growing professionally, whether that's creating custom software for clients or driving the development of an in-house product.
home.bioParagraph2: To get to know me better, I invite you to explore my portfolio. In the projects section and on my personal blog, where I document my progress, you can take a look at the personal developments I regularly work on. In them, I put into practice what I've learned and explore new tools to continue expanding my technical skills.
home.bioParagraph3: If my profile fits what you are looking for, I would love to chat. You can find my email, phone number, and LinkedIn profile in the Contact section.
home.experienceIntroText: My professional profile stands out for high adaptability and a mindset geared towards continuous learning. Through team coordination, I have developed the agility to solve problems under pressure, providing analytical value and maintaining smooth communication with clients and colleagues in both English and Spanish.
home.exp_xeridia_desc: Developed a Jira plugin for user management. Coordinated a 4-person team, taking ownership of key technical decisions and maintaining constant communication with clients and stakeholders.
home.exp_restauracion_desc: Maintained operational efficiency in high-demand environments. Agile incident resolution and quick adaptation to strict safety protocols and standards through coordination and multitasking.
home.exp_estalmat_desc: Participation in an intensive program for the detection and development of mathematical talent. Acquired advanced skills in logic, complex problem solving, and abstract thinking.

projects.introText1: Welcome to the section of my personal projects. Here you can explore the different works I invest my time in, which are the main driver that helps me stay in constant learning and evolution. You will find developments of various types, and I always have new ideas in mind ready to come to life in the future.
projects.introText2: If you are looking for something specific, you can use the filter on the page to explore the projects based on the technologies and tools I have used in each of them.
projects.cgruleengine_desc:
My Bachelor's Thesis (graded with a 9.9 and nominated for graduation with honors) consisted of the development of CGRuleEngine, a software tool programmed in C# (.NET Standard 2.1) designed to facilitate and streamline the development of card video games by completely isolating the business logic from the graphical layer. It is a modular, robust, scalable, and agnostic rule engine, capable of automatically managing the entire technical infrastructure of a match, including turn control, players, zones, and effect resolution through a stack structure.
If you would like to know more about my work, I invite you to take a look at the project report.
projects.godotcstoolbox_desc:
Godot CS Toolbox consists of an ever-evolving collection of utilities and scripts for the Godot engine. More than a comercial or closed product, this project serves as an experimental space. It is designed to speed up the implementation of prototypes and common mechanics, solve recurring problems, and help establish a clean, reusable, and much more solid architecture for any game project.
This personal project was born purely for fun and as the perfect excuse to dive into the world of game development, while continuing to improve and polish my knowledge of the C# language.
projects.personalweb_desc: The website where you are reading this is also a personal development project, conceived both as a professional portfolio and a platform for sharing content. The platform is structured into four main sections: Home, Projects, Blog, and Contact. On a technical level, the project blends the speed and efficiency of a purely static website with the versatility of a full frontend and backend architecture to manage dynamic content. The entire visual design has been built from scratch using custom CSS, with a strong focus on responsiveness to ensure full support and a seamless mobile experience.
